note: Camping here is on or beside the area's two small gravel parking lots, each marked by MDC as a primitive camping area: this one on Stahl Road at the south edge, with a mown opening beside it, and a second on Spring Creek Road at the north edge. No pads, tables or toilets; wooded hills all round. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: camping is lot camping that MDC designates (map Primitive Camping Area symbol and a GIS 'Designated Camping Area' point at each of the two lots; brochure 'on or adjacent to all area parking lots') - stays under the Lick Creek reading of the lot rule, flagged for the owner. Pin is on the south lot, the better of the two. Phone matches. No split.
flags: LOT RULE - STAYS, OWNER TO CONFIRM: the brochure says 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all area parking lots.' and 'Walk-in/backpack camping is allowed EXCEPT during all firearms deer and turkey seasons.' The map (04/13) puts a Primitive Camping Area symbol beside each of the two Parking Lot squares, and GIS layer 27 has a 'Designated Camping Area' point at each lot (581 at 40.28435,-92.80087, 6 m from lot 2430; 580 at 40.29403,-92.79914, 13 m from lot 3188). So there is a designated camping point at each lot (keeps it, as Lick Creek), but on imagery neither is anything more than a lot: the south one a gravel pad about 35 x 20 m off Stahl Road with a mown lane/opening running north from it, the north one a gravel pad about 25 x 18 m directly off Spring Creek Road with a small mown margin. No pads, rings or tables visible.
PIN: stored 40.28435,-92.80087 is the south lot's GIS camping point, on the gravel. No move. The north lot is 1.09 km away on a different road (Spring Creek Road) but is a single small lot: no split.

ACCESS: both lots are directly on gravel county roads (map legend: Gravel Road); no low-water crossing, 4WD wording or posted limit on the page, brochure or map. Spring Creek crosses the north part of the area but neither lot's approach crosses it on the map.
PHONE: stored 660-785-2420 matches the page's 'For more information call (660) 785-2420'.
Brochure also says 'No unattended open campfires allowed.' Stored year_round (manual) stands; the seasonal limit is on walk-in camping only.
